description: 6K is behind the world’s only production-scale microwave plasma system for advanced materials, which operates at 6000 degrees. Their proprietary advanced plasma processing and industrial systems are used to economically and sustainably create materials that are enabling the next generation of commercial and consumer products in industries that range from Additive Manufacturing to Batteries to Lighting & Displays.

actnano creates water and environmental resistant nanocoating technology primarily used to protect electronics in automotive and consumer electronics from water damage and harsh environmental conditions. The company’s advanced, sustainable nanoGuard coatings can be applied directly on connectors, antennas, LEDs, and high heat-generating components to comprehensively safeguard electronics with no changes to existing manufacturing lines.

AgZen is the pioneer of feedback-optimized agriculture, a new approach that improves outcomes and reduces costs for every part of the direct-ag-inputs industry. AgZen’s patented sprayer retrofits and formulations, developed at MIT, allow farmers to spray 50% less pesticides while maintaining crop health and yield.

Amperesand's power infrastructure solution enables the integration of all types of renewable power generation into both existing and future electrical grids. Thanks to its proprietary solid-state transformer (SST) technology, the system natively provides grid-level management solutions, such as energy and data management, bidirectional flow, mixed AC/DC loads, all in a more efficient and flexible solution. Amperesand's modular SST approach to grid electrification uses a fraction of the raw material used in traditional transformers and provides a significant reduction in GHG over their operational lifecycle.

Bloomer Tech is focused on accelerating cardiovascular research and improving patient care through personalized diagnostics for women. Their novel technology includes a wearable electrocardiogram device that looks and feels like a bra and a patient-facing app that shows key metrics and has interactive tools to help women improve their heart health.

CorePower Magnetics develops and manufactures advanced magnetic components that enable the next generation of power electronics. By taking a holistic approach from magnetic materials to component design and manufacturing expertise, CorePower delivers smaller, lighter, and more efficient inductors and transformers for applications including AI infrastructure, data centers, grid modernization, and industrial electrification.

Datacule has developed a data storage solution that encodes data in mixtures of small molecules, deposits it on a surface, and stores it for on-demand optical retrieval. Their solution is long-lasting, sustainable, and inexpensive, leveraging chemistry and additive printing to securely encode and store information.

​​Debut produces high-value ingredients for the cosmetic, food, and health & wellness markets rapidly and more sustainably. Low-value and sustainable feedstocks can be used as inputs in place of petrochemicals, while reactions can be generated in a fraction of the time. These breakthroughs result in a more sustainable and cost-effective approach to manufacturing ingredients, including those inaccessible in nature.

DetraPel specializes in sustainable, non-toxic protective coatings that provide much-needed alternatives to PFAS-based “forever chemicals”. Their technology has applications in a diverse range of consumer and industrial end markets from packaging to textiles.

Essara Health is building Digitally Enhanced Pharmaceuticals™, a medical-grade smart ring paired with FDA-cleared software that captures what happens to Parkinson's patients between clinic visits, converting everyday movement into the disease-specific data that helps patients, physicians, and pharmaceutical partners personalize treatment.
Fleet Robotics provides an innovative underwater robotics platform that will transform offshore procedures like routine inspection and maintenance of ocean-dwelling products.

Folio Photonics is reinventing archival storage with modern optical storage technology. The company’s patented solution, the data film disc, is a multi-terabyte, multilayer fluorescent optical disc with a decades-long shelf-life, small environmental footprint, and low total cost of ownership.
Foundation Alloy designs novel alloys that are optimized for additive manufacturing to support some of the world’s most important products and industries.

Fusion Coolant Systems develops and commercializes an advanced coolant and lubricant for the machining industry that leverages supercritical CO2. Their breakthrough coolant technology offers sustainability, safety, and cost-efficiency benefits for manufacturers.

GALY leverages plant stem cells to grow high-quality cotton in a lab instead of on big farms, at a rate that is ten times faster than traditional cotton farming. With a process that uses 77% less water, 80% less land and emits an 84% smaller CO2 footprint than traditional cotton manufacturing, Galy’s goal is to safeguard the environment and transition the world to cellular agriculture.
Gen Phoenix rescues leather offcuts destined for landfill and regenerates them into a premium, durable leather material coveted by the world’s most iconic brands for its beauty and durability.

Huue is using UC Berkeley bioengineering research to develop sustainable biosynthetic dyes that offer a highly effective alternative to conventional dye manufacturing. Their environmentally friendly process requires no fossil fuels and creates significantly less pollution than traditional technologies.

Infinite Cooling is changing the way industries around the world consume freshwater. Their product reduces the water consumption and water treatment costs of a variety of industrial processes by using a novel electric field technology to recover and recycle the water from cooling tower exhausts.

Jump Aero is developing technology for electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircrafts to safely cut emergency response times in half for first responders. Designed specifically for first responder needs, the company’s vehicle leverages an electric motor that is wheels-up in less than 30 seconds and can carry all necessary equipment required for a first responder’s mission.
Koloma develops technology to produce clean, cost-effective geologic hydrogen.

description: Lynq is building instant-on, scalable, and secure communication networks used by first responders, government agencies, and enterprises to connect people and equipment in complex environments with no or unreliable connectivity.

Maglev Aero is developing the quietest, highest-performing and safest all-electric zero-emission vertical-takeoff and landing (VTOL) passenger/cargo aircraft to meet the mass market requirements of the emerging $1.5 Trillion/year Urban Air Mobility Market.
Mattiq creates proprietary megalibraries of nanomaterials on a single chip that is then used to accelerate the discovery and development of sustainable products in a wide range of industrial sectors.

NanoGraf is an advanced battery material company whose patented silicon-anode technology enables longer-lasting, higher-energy, and higher-power lithium-ion batteries for a range of applications, from consumer electronics to electric vehicles.

Nauticus Robotics is developing an ultra-sustainable fleet of marine robotics powered by intelligent software, providing offshore industry customers with a tetherless autonomous robot that can perform subsea work with a significant reduction in cost and GHG emissions. The technology is streamlining operations and reducing the carbon cost of developing the ocean’s resources.

NextGen Jane uses a patented smart tampon technology to collect menstrual and cervicovaginal samples used to conduct diagnostic tests for reproductive healthcare conditions. By offering women a comfortable and easy-to-use testing option, Jane is moving the locus of power and health management from clinics to consumers.

Orbion Space Technology develops high-performing, fuel-efficient plasma electric thrusters for the growing small satellite market. By leveraging existing robotic tactical missile manufacturing techniques, Orbion is mass-manufacturing its Aurora Plasma Propulsion System to meet the rising demands of New Space customers.

Oxipital AI is a leader in AI-enabled machine vision technologies for robotic process automation and product inspection in critical industries such as food processing, agriculture, and consumer goods production. The company's mission is to deliver actionable insights through deep object understanding, to customers, as they embrace Industry 5.0 and to unlock previously unachievable levels of resiliency, efficiency, and sustainability in their manufacturing operations.

Berkeley-based Ripple Foods is a leader in developing innovative and delicious dairy-free products. Using protein from yellow peas, Ripple Foods creates creamy and protein-filled products like Plant-Based Milk, Protein Shakes, and Half & Half. Sustainably produced and using significantly less water than dairy and other dairy alternatives, Ripple is a Certified Benefit Corporation, proudly built on transparency that even the smallest actions can have far-reaching impacts. Ripple products are gluten-free, 100% vegan, certified non-GMO and made without nuts, lactose and soy.

Sonera Magnetics is developing novel sensing technology for high-performance, non-invasive brain-computer interfaces to democratize access to the brain. Their core technology detects signals from the brain at performance levels comparable to the best diagnostic tools without relying on superconducting sensors.

SOURCE is the maker of Hydropanels™, which creates clean drinking water using only sunlight and air in an effort to make drinking water an unlimited resource. Their material science innovation gives people in nearly every climate and corner of the world the ability to produce safe, high-quality water.

Still Bright is poised to revolutionize copper production. Still Bright is commercializing a patented hydrometallurgical process to enable fast, low-cost conversion to refined copper from both traditional copper resources like concentrated high-grade copper ore, as well as non-traditional resources like mining waste and milled ore.

Talus Renewables pioneered the first commercial, modular, zero-carbon green ammonia system that makes the production and distribution of a critical raw material cheaper, cleaner, and more reliable. Talus locally produces lower-cost, carbon-free ammonia at or near the point of use, creating value for multiple industries. The talusOne and talusTen operate on intermittent renewable power and are fully containerized and modular, enabling rapid deployments and scaling. TalusAg, a subsidiary of Talus Renewables, focuses on green ammonia production for the agriculture sector.

Tierra Biosciences is a synthetic biology company that accelerates the pace of discovery to enable the next generation of bio-based materials. Tierra’s Protein Platform couples high-throughput protein manufacturing with the simplicity of e-commerce to make ordering custom proteins easier than ever before. By lowering traditional protein synthesis barriers, Tierra serves researchers looking to change the world with novel proteins.
